class.name: OcgBrepfeatMakerevol
class.brief_description: Describes functions to build revolved shells from basis shapes.
class.description: ! Describes functions to build revolved shells from basis shapes.

method.name: from_2
method.description: a face Pbase is selected in the shape Sbase to serve as the basis for the revolved shell. The revolution will be defined by the axis Axis and Fuse offers a choice between: - removing matter with a Boolean cut using the setting 0 - adding matter with Boolean fusion using the setting 1. The sketch face Skface serves to determine the type of operation. If it is inside the basis shape, a local operation such as glueing can be performed.

method.name: Add
method.description: Indicates that the edge <E> will slide on the face <OnFace>. Raises ConstructionError if the face does not belong to the basis shape, or the edge to the prismed shape.

method.name: PerformThruAll
method.description: Builds an infinite shell. The infinite descendants will not be kept in the result.

method.name: PerformUntilAngle
method.description: Assigns both a limiting shape, Until from TopoDS_Shape, and an angle, Angle at which to stop generation of the revolved shell feature.
